paragraphs.text: translated by
1. THOU wast born mighty for victorious valour, exulting, strongest, full of pride and courage.
paragraphs.original: जनिष्ठा उग्रः सहसे तुराय मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो बहुलाभिमानः ।
paragraphs.translit: janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya mandra ojiṣṭho bahulābhimānaḥ |

paragraphs.text: There, even there, the Maruts strengthened Indra when. his most rapid Mother stirred the Hero.
paragraphs.original: अवर्धन्निन्द्रं मरुतश्चिदत्र माता यद्वीरं दधनद्धनिष्ठा
paragraphs.translit: avardhannindraṃ marutaścidatra mātā yadvīraṃ dadhanaddhaniṣṭhā

paragraphs.text: 2. There with fiend's ways e'en Prsni was seated: with much laudation they exalted Indra.
paragraphs.original: द्रुहो निषत्ता पृशनी चिदेवैः पुरू शंसेन वावृधुष्ट इन्द्रम् ।
paragraphs.translit: druho niṣattā pṛśanī cidevaiḥ purū śaṃsena vāvṛdhuṣṭa indram |

paragraphs.text: As if encompassed by the Mighty-footed, from darkness, near at hand, forth came the Children.
paragraphs.original: अभीवृतेव ता महापदेन ध्वान्तात्प्रपित्वादुदरन्त गर्भाः
paragraphs.translit: abhīvṛteva tā mahāpadena dhvāntātprapitvādudaranta garbhāḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. High are thy feet when on thy way thou goest: the strength thou foundest here hath lent thee vigour.
paragraphs.original: ऋष्वा ते पादा प्र यज्जिगास्यवर्धन्वाजा उत ये चिदत्र ।
paragraphs.translit: ṛṣvā te pādā pra yajjigāsyavardhanvājā uta ye cidatra |

paragraphs.text: Thousand hyenas in thy mouth thou holdest. O Indra, mayst thou turn the Asvins hither.
paragraphs.original: त्वमिन्द्र सालावृकान्सहस्रमासन्दधिषे अश्विना ववृत्याः
paragraphs.translit: tvamindra sālāvṛkānsahasramāsandadhiṣe aśvinā vavṛtyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Speeding at once to sacrifice thou comest for friendship thou art bringing both Nasatyas.
paragraphs.original: समना तूर्णिरुप यासि यज्ञमा नासत्या सख्याय वक्षि ।
paragraphs.translit: samanā tūrṇirupa yāsi yajñamā nāsatyā sakhyāya vakṣi |

paragraphs.text: Thou hadst a thousand treasures in possession. The Asvins, O thou Hero, gave thee riches.
paragraphs.original: वसाव्यामिन्द्र धारयः सहस्राश्विना शूर ददतुर्मघानि
paragraphs.translit: vasāvyāmindra dhārayaḥ sahasrāśvinā śūra dadaturmaghāni

paragraphs.text: 5. Glad, for the race that rests on holy Order, with friends who hasten to their goal, hath Indra
paragraphs.original: मन्दमान ऋतादधि प्रजायै सखिभिरिन्द्र इषिरेभिरर्थम् ।
paragraphs.translit: mandamāna ṛtādadhi prajāyai sakhibhirindra iṣirebhirartham |

paragraphs.text: With these his magic powers assailed the Dasyu: he cast away the gloomy mists, the darkness.
paragraphs.original: आभिर्हि माया उप दस्युमागान्मिहः प्र तम्रा अवपत्तमांसि
paragraphs.translit: ābhirhi māyā upa dasyumāgānmihaḥ pra tamrā avapattamāṃsi

paragraphs.text: 6. Two of like name for him didst thou demolish, as Indra striking down the car of Usas.
paragraphs.original: सनामाना चिद्ध्वसयो न्यस्मा अवाहन्निन्द्र उषसो यथानः ।
paragraphs.translit: sanāmānā ciddhvasayo nyasmā avāhannindra uṣaso yathānaḥ |

paragraphs.text: With thy beloved lofty Friends thou camest, and with the assurance of thine heart thou slewest.
paragraphs.original: ऋष्वैरगच्छः सखिभिर्निकामैः साकं प्रतिष्ठा हृद्या जघन्थ
paragraphs.translit: ṛṣvairagacchaḥ sakhibhirnikāmaiḥ sākaṃ pratiṣṭhā hṛdyā jaghantha

paragraphs.text: 7. War-loving Namuci thou smotest, robbing the Dasa of his magic for the Rsi.
paragraphs.original: त्वं जघन्थ नमुचिं मखस्युं दासं कृण्वान ऋषये विमायम् ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ jaghantha namuciṃ makhasyuṃ dāsaṃ kṛṇvāna ṛṣaye vimāyam |

paragraphs.text: For man thou madest ready pleasant pathways, paths leading as it were directly God-ward.
paragraphs.original: त्वं चकर्थ मनवे स्योनान्पथो देवत्राञ्जसेव यानान्
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ cakartha manave syonānpatho devatrāñjaseva yānān

paragraphs.text: 8. These names of thine thou hast fulfilled completely: as Lord, thou boldest in thine arm, O Indra.
paragraphs.original: त्वमेतानि पप्रिषे वि नामेशान इन्द्र दधिषे गभस्तौ ।
paragraphs.translit: tvametāni papriṣe vi nāmeśāna indra dadhiṣe gabhastau |

paragraphs.text: In thee, through thy great might, the Gods are joyful: the roots of trees hast thou directed upward.
paragraphs.original: अनु त्वा देवाः शवसा मदन्त्युपरिबुध्नान्वनिनश्चकर्थ
paragraphs.translit: anu tvā devāḥ śavasā madantyuparibudhnānvaninaścakartha

paragraphs.text: 9. May the sweet Soma juices make him happy to cast his quoit that lies in depth of waters.
paragraphs.original: चक्रं यदस्याप्स्वा निषत्तमुतो तदस्मै मध्विच्चच्छद्यात् ।
paragraphs.translit: cakraṃ yadasyāpsvā niṣattamuto tadasmai madhviccacchadyāt |

paragraphs.text: Thou from the udder which o'er earth is fastened hast poured the milk into the kine and herbage.
paragraphs.original: पृथिव्यामतिषितं यदूधः पयो गोष्वदधा ओषधीषु
paragraphs.translit: pṛthivyāmatiṣitaṃ yadūdhaḥ payo goṣvadadhā oṣadhīṣu

paragraphs.text: 10. When others call him offspring of the Courser, my meaning is that Mighty Power produced him.
paragraphs.original: अश्वादियायेति यद्वदन्त्योजसो जातमुत मन्य एनम् ।
paragraphs.translit: aśvādiyāyeti yadvadantyojaso jātamuta manya enam |

paragraphs.text: He came from Manyu and remained in houses: whence he hath sprung is known to Indra only.
paragraphs.original: मन्योरियाय हर्म्येषु तस्थौ यतः प्रजज्ञ इन्द्रो अस्य वेद
paragraphs.translit: manyoriyāya harmyeṣu tasthau yataḥ prajajña indro asya veda

paragraphs.text: 11. Like birds of beauteous wing the Priyamedhas, Rsis, imploring, have come nigh to Indra:
paragraphs.original: वयः सुपर्णा उप सेदुरिन्द्रं प्रियमेधा ऋषयो नाधमानाः ।
paragraphs.translit: vayaḥ suparṇā upa sedurindraṃ priyamedhā ṛṣayo nādhamānāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Dispel the darkness and fill full our vision deliver us as men whom snares entangle.
paragraphs.original: अप ध्वान्तमूर्णुहि पूर्धि चक्षुर्मुमुग्ध्यस्मान्निधयेव बद्धान्
paragraphs.translit: apa dhvāntamūrṇuhi pūrdhi cakṣurmumugdhyasmānnidhayeva baddhān
